title: Shared run state
description: orchestrator/runs/<client>/<run-id>/state.json — the single shared run record both tracks are dispatched under. Distinct from, and never a replacement for, each track's own runs/<client>/<run-id>/state.json.

backendRunRef.description: backend/runs/<client>/<run-id>/ path this shared run's backend result was composed from.

frontendRunRef.description: frontend/runs/<client>/<run-id>/ path this shared run's frontend result was composed from.

ingestCandidateRef.description: ingest/knowledge/candidates/releases/<version>.json this run's requirements were split from.
